name: Neuenkirchen (Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany)
description: Horizontal stripes of blue and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Neuenkirchen (three yellow squirrels on blue above a chequy field with a shield).
history: The arms were approved on 15 October 1998 and registered as no. 171 in the roll of arms of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the flag, designed by Frank Weichbrodt of Neuenkirchen, was approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 19 November 2009.
